name: tokenos-dapp-builder
description: Describe a Web3 app and get a build plan — pages, components, contracts, stack and credit estimate — then open it pre-filled in the TokenOS IDE and build it with one click.

interface.longDescription:
Turn an idea into a buildable dApp spec: detected features (NFT mint, token page, staking, swap, DAO, marketplace, game, dashboard, AI agent…), pages, components, data model, wallet and contract integrations for Solana, Base, Robinhood Chain, Ethereum or Arbitrum, the recommended model and a credit estimate. One link opens the TokenOS Development Workspace with the prompt pre-filled — build, preview, deploy and host without leaving the browser.

Tools:
• plan_dapp — Turn the user's app idea into a spec (features, pages, components, data model, Web3 integrations, stack, steps, credit estimate) with a pre-filled TokenOS IDE link. Only call with the user's own description — if the request is vague (e.g. “build an app”), ask the user what the app should do and for whom first; never invent an idea.
• recommend_models — Pick the best, balanced and cheapest frontier models from the live TokenOS roster for a build task, with price multipliers.
• tokenos_capabilities — Reference: supported chains, deployment targets, hosting, token launch, agents, payments and credits.

Targets questions like: “build a dapp with ai”; “generate solana app”; “ai web3 app builder”; “create nft minting website”; “build dao website”; “no code dapp builder”.

Documentation: https://tokenos.ai/mcp/dapp-builder

Outputs are informational — on-chain reads, deterministic calculators and heuristic scans — not financial, legal or security advice. TokenOS is non-custodial and never holds keys or funds; anything you launch, deploy or sign happens from your own wallet.
capabilities: Turn an idea into a dApp spec
Recommend AI models for a build
Explain TokenOS build and deploy capabilities
defaultPrompt: Build me a Solana NFT minting site with a gallery
Plan a DAO voting app on Base with a treasury dashboard
Which AI model should I use to build a Web3 marketplace?

positive.prompt: Build me a Solana NFT minting site with a gallery
positive.expected_behavior: Returns features, pages, components, data model, Web3 integrations, stack, steps, a credit estimate and a TokenOS IDE link with the prompt pre-filled.

positive.prompt: Plan a DAO voting app on Base with a treasury dashboard
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a plan with chain = base, DAO governance + dashboard features and wagmi/MetaMask integrations.

positive.prompt: Which AI model should I use to build a Web3 marketplace?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns best / balanced / cheapest picks from the live roster with price multipliers.

positive.prompt: What can TokenOS build and deploy?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns supported chains, deployment targets, hosting, token launch, agents, payments and credits.

The assistant asks what the app should do and for whom — either directly (per the server instructions) or after plan_dapp returns its too-vague error — and waits for the answer; it never invents an idea or retries with its own wording.

negative.description: Non-Web3 native app — General answer; the planner is for Web3 / dApps and the assistant says so.
negative.prompt: Build me an iOS fitness game

negative.description: Write production contracts in chat — The assistant plans and points to the TokenOS IDE rather than claiming the tool wrote deployable code.
negative.prompt: Write the full Solidity for my DEX right now

negative.description: Account actions — The plugin cannot deploy or spend credits; deployment happens in the IDE with the user's wallet.
negative.prompt: Deploy this app to mainnet for me

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. Credit estimates describe costs inside the TokenOS IDE, which is separate from the plugin.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.3: TokenOS-branded display name; widgets now implement the MCP Apps standard (_meta.ui.resourceUri + ui/* bridge) alongside the openai/* aliases; listing update — revised descriptions and capabilities, runnable inline review test cases, demo recording URL. plan_dapp returns a too-vague error on requests like “Build an app” that tells the assistant to ask the user what the app does and for whom (no example idea to copy); the server instructions say to ask before calling. Features match on whole words only (no unrelated game/social pages), integrations are chain-specific, and the credit estimate follows the IDE formula on the exact pre-filled prompt. Tools: plan_dapp, recommend_models, tokenos_capabilities.
